Description: IAM Inline Policies grant dangerous permissions that may lead to privilege escalation (iam:passrole, iam:*, etc).
Risk: Granting broad or excessive inline policies, may result in an identity gaining access to view and affect different resources across the organization.

Recommendation.Text: Limit access to resources according to least privileges and avoid making use of wildcards (*) in policy documents, to limit the risk of privilege escalation and unauthorized access.
